title: Cisco IOS XE web UI privilege escalation (creates admin account)
description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can create a privilege-15 account through the HTTP/HTTPS web UI and take full control of the device. Release trains without a listed fix are reported as affected; confirm newer trains against the Cisco advisory.
remediation: Upgrade to a fixed release (17.9.4a, 17.6.6a, 17.3.8a, 16.12.10a or later). Until then run 'no ip http server' and 'no ip http secure-server', and check for unknown local accounts.

title: Cisco IOS XE web UI command injection (root implant)
description: Used together with CVE-2023-20198 to run commands as root and install an implant. Release trains without a listed fix are reported as affected; confirm newer trains against the Cisco advisory.
remediation: Upgrade to a fixed release. Until then disable the HTTP/HTTPS server.

title: Cisco ASA web services read-only path traversal
description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can read files from the web services file system when WebVPN or AnyConnect is configured.
remediation: Upgrade to a fixed release for your train (e.g. 9.8.4.20, 9.12.3.12, 9.14.1.10 or later). Trains with no fix (9.7 and older than 9.6) need a move to a supported train.

title: PHP2Shell: PHP memory corruption on out-of-memory handling (remote code execution)
description: Crafted multipart requests can corrupt memory while PHP handles an out-of-memory condition, leading to unauthenticated remote code execution. Affects mod_php, PHP-FPM, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed. Exploited in the wild; on CISA KEV.
remediation: Upgrade PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 or later (Linux distribution packages: install the vendor's security update). PHP 8.1 and older get no official fix: move to a supported branch. Interim only (partial): set session.upload_progress.enabled=0, block multipart/form-data requests at the WAF where uploads aren't needed, or put the application behind network-level authentication.

title: PHP2Shell: PHP stale global state (remote code execution)
description: Companion flaw to CVE-2026-109618 fixed in the same releases, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. Exploited in the wild; on CISA KEV.
remediation: Upgrade PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 or later (Linux distribution packages: install the vendor's security update). PHP 8.1 and older get no official fix: move to a supported branch. Interim only (partial): set session.upload_progress.enabled=0, block multipart/form-data requests at the WAF where uploads aren't needed, or put the application behind network-level authentication.
